desc:
🏃 RUN. 🎳 BOWL. SURVIVE.

Every round, a few players hop onto giant rolling balls: the Bowlers. Everyone else is a Runner. Sprint across the arena, dodge the balls and reach the safe zone... then turn around and do it all over again!

Get hit and you’re out, but not for long. You come back as a Bowler on your own giant ball, ready to hunt down the remaining Runners.

🏃 RUNNERS: cross to the safe zone, wait for your team, then run back. Every crossing earns coins.
🎳 BOWLERS: steer your giant ball and bowl the runners before they make it across.

✨ Earn coins every round and spend them on ball skins, trails, death effects and hit sounds.
⏱ 5-minute rounds. Fast, chaotic, hilarious.
👥 Grab your friends: more players, more chaos!
